properties.note: Drawn by scripts/propose_calibration_candidates.py --towns: a building drawn at random from every building in the density grid, and the 1 km box centred on it, kept because it holds 1,413 buildings (1,413 per km2, VIDA; a town is 800 or more). No classifier score and no look for solar went into the draw, so a town without solar is as likely as one with it: map every installation, ground and rooftop, and if there is none, say the box was checked in full. Esri imagery here dates from 2025-07-22 (oldest of centre and corners), no older than 2024-10-01 for a composite starting 2025-10-01. Do not move it toward visible solar.
